title: Elux Firerose 5000 White Gummy 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: White Gummy from the Elux Firerose 5000 collection combines the tropical taste of pineapple with the sweet chewiness of gummy confectionary. This e-liquid offers a delightful confectionary experience, perfect for those who enjoy fruity and sweet vape flavours. The smooth inhale delivers the tropical taste of pineapple, while the exhale brings a sweet gummy confectionary finish, creating a balanced and enjoyable vaping experience. The combination of fruit and confectionary notes makes this flavour a favourite for all-day vaping. With a 50VG/50PG blend, Berry Bang ensures a perfectly balanced vape that’s ideal for those who enjoy both intense flavour and satisfying yet discreet cloud production. The Nicotine Salt formulation provides a silky smoothness of the vape and is suitable for use in any MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping device. Discover the delicious world of Elux Firerose 5000 Nic Salt e-liquids. This captivating range is inspired by some of Elux’s most popular disposable vape flavours, offering the same intensity of flavour but with the versatility and convenience that comes from 10ml bottles for use with a wide variety of vape devices. Experience all dozen delicious Elux Firerose flavours available at Vapestore.
